note: no priors on the brms side: brms's defaults are the model (each component's Intercept student_t(3, round(median(y), 1), max(2.5, round(mad(y), 1))), flat b, sigma1 and sigma2 student_t(3, 0, 2.5) with lower bound 0, theta dirichlet(1)); AutoBayes builds it with ab.default_priors(family='mixture', families=[...]), whose intercept priors are one prior for every component (the sorted-draws path of the ordered intercepts)
